saw_lines: Supplement buyers check the reviews before they read the label, and they trust a tub other lifters already finished.
So the sale is lost when the ad skips proof, and a new lifter who doubts the tub scrolls past.
Your site shows 10147 reviews, yet 0 of 2 ads carry any proof number. Put 10147 on the creative and open both ads with a review quote.
ads_1: Story ads opening on a review quote, with Machine Whey Protein as the product
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube
